_comment: Approval routing of record (team/TEAM_MODEL.md §12; tiers A/B/C, requester exclusion, owner SoD). Consumed by the approval flow behind the workflows' approvalWebhookUrl (Power Automate or Function). The flow MUST: (1) resolve the tier from 'kind' in the subscribe body — for REPORT_DELIVERY from 'reportType' via tier_by_reportType; (2) verify the approver's token UPN is a member of every group in 'approver_groups' (Graph checkMemberGroups); (3) reject when approver == requestedBy (requestedBy is a token claim set by the workflow — delta D-W1/D-W2 — never body text); (4) apply the tier's fallback / requester_is_owner_fallback rule and stamp its ruleId; (5) persist the 'record.fields' before POSTing {decision, approver} to callbackUrl. Group names are Entra ID security groups (team/TEAM_MODEL.md §6); ids and UPNs are placeholders.

requester_is_owner_fallback.note: TEMPLATE_UPDATE: deputy approves after the visual-diff review; PLATFORM_CHANGE: deputy is the required CODEOWNERS reviewer, the owner merges and approves the production environment as accountable; MEMORY_DELETE: deputy approves when the owner is the note author

record.store: SharePoint list {list:ApprovalDecisions} on the InfoSec Assurance site (site members: Read; the approval flow's connection: write); filed under Governance/Approvals/
record.retention: P1Y minimum (DORA Art. 28 evidence); aligned to the ISMS record schedule
record.quality_sampling: quarterly: 10 % of Tier A decisions and 100 % of Tier B fallbacks compared with the stored deliverable (team/TEAM_MODEL.md §12.1; QUARTERLY_ACCESS_REVIEW item 13)
